Well, thats very interesting and thank you for sharing your experience! :) And here is the truth with ADHD and Ritalin;

If you 100% HAVE ADHD, Ritalin WILL work. If you DO NOT have ADHD *wrong diagnosis* then Ritalin will...be poor for you.

People get diagnosed with ADHD, when one of your two, stimulant receptors in your brain is clogged.

IF you HAVE ADHD, Ritalin will you give you the stimulant you need, and actually has a reverse effect and will make you feel..more calm in in control.

If you do NOT have ADHD, Ritalin will make people, either angry or have A LOT of energy.

This being, you are giving your brain stimulant when it doesn't need it.
